svg.text: GOOGLE CLOUD TPU INFERENCE SERVING: vLLM-TPU VS. JETSTREAM, PALLAS & ICI P/D SPLIT
vLLM-TPU V1 + Pallas Ragged PagedAttention + ICI P/D Split Hits 14.8ms TPOT & $0.21/1M
64-Chip Serving Slice (8K In / 512 Out): Tier 1 Unbucketed (115ms TPOT, $420K/mo) vs. Tier 2 JetStream vs. Tier 4 ($112K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Runtime Recompiles & Prefill Stalls
1. Unbucketed Serving Triggers 45s Live XLA Recompiles (115ms TPOT):
• Serving dynamic batch/token shapes without AOT bucketing freezes
live user streams; contiguous KV slots waste 68% of HBM
2. Co-Located Prefill/Decode Contention on 8K–32K Prompts (42ms):
• Compute-heavy Prefill bursts monopolize the `MXU`, stalling
co-located memory-bound Decode tokens past the 25ms SLA
3. Missing VMEM DMA Prefetch on Non-Contiguous KV Pages:
• Naive gather-scatter KV paging starves HBM bandwidth (22% MBU)
Production Failure Impact (64-Chip TPU Serving Pool):
• P99 Decode TPOT: 115.0ms (Tier 1) | 42.0ms (Tier 2 Co-Located)
• Decode HBM Bandwidth Utilization (MBU): Only 22.0% (Tier 1)
• Monthly SLA-Compliant Serving TCO: $420,000 / month ($1.65/1M)
🏆 Tier 4: vLLM-TPU V1 + Pallas PA + ICI P/D Split
1. Persistent XLA Compilation Cache + Exponential Token Buckets:
• Pre-warms `(num_tokens, batch)` buckets from shared GCS/Hyperdisk
at boot (`0` runtime recompiles, `<28s` KEDA/GKE replica scale-out)
2. `Pallas Ragged PagedAttention` + On-Chip `VMEM` DMA (79.4% MBU):
• Async DMAs 16/32-token KV blocks from HBM into `VMEM` scratchpad
overlapped with `MXU` attention scoring + Prefix Caching
3. Intra-Slice `ICI` Prefill/Decode Disaggregation (14.8ms TPOT):
• Transfers 32K KV over `1.2 Tbps ICI` in `<6ms` (`$0.21/1M` tokens)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• P99 Decode TPOT: 14.8 ms (-87.1% vs. Tier 1; 100% <=25ms SLA)
• Decode HBM MBU: 79.4% | Serving Cost: $0.21 / 1M Tokens
• Monthly Total TCO: $112,000 / mo (-73.3% savings vs. Tier 1)
